rows.name: ManualCoordinationLagHazard
rows.text: Sector assignment, handover, re-spread and deconfliction done by hand lag behind events, and a sector goes unwatched.

rows.name: UnrecoveredDroneHazard
rows.text: A drone that has lost contact with the swarm keeps flying with nowhere to go and becomes a hazard.

rows.name: ReportLostInLinkGapHazard
rows.text: A detection report is sent into a link gap and nobody knows it never arrived.

rows.name: WatchBeyondClearanceHazard
rows.text: A drone keeps flying its watch after the airspace clearance has been withdrawn.

rows.name: RecallWins
rows.text: Once a drone is recalled, it does not watch again until it has landed.

rows.name: ReturnsWhenIsolated
rows.text: From any situation a drone can be in, it can always get back to landed; an isolated drone included.

rows.name: GeofenceBreachEndsWatch
rows.text: Once a drone is outside its cleared airspace, it does not watch until it has landed.

rows.name: QuarantinedStaysOut
rows.text: Once a drone is quarantined, it takes no part in coordination until it has been readmitted.

rows.name: PositionDriftHazard
rows.text: Without satellite positioning, a drone's position estimate drifts and its reports place objects in the wrong place.

rows.name: MeshJammingHazard
rows.text: Interference cuts the links between drones, and coordination stalls.

rows.name: MisclassificationHazard
rows.text: A detection is reported as the wrong class, or a forced class where Unknown was the truth.

rows.name: SensingDegradedUnnoticedHazard
rows.text: A sensor degrades and nobody knows the reports from it are unreliable.

rows.name: StaleTrackHazard
rows.text: A track is shown as current after nothing has seen the object for a while.

rows.name: SpoofedMemberHazard
rows.text: Something that is not one of the drones joins the mesh and takes part in coordination.

rows.name: MixedClassifierVersionsHazard
rows.text: Drones run different classifier versions and classify the same object differently.

rows.name: OperatorOverloadHazard
rows.text: More alerts reach the operator than they can judge, and they accept what is in front of them.

rows.name: CoordinationConcentrationHazard
rows.text: About the coordination and command-and-control functions of the logical system: if they end up on one component, a ground station or a single member, the loss of that component stalls sector hand-over, rotation and redistribution for the whole swarm.

rows.name: SectorHandOffLostHazard
rows.text: About handOverSector between members: a member leaves to recharge before the neighbour has taken the sector, because the hand-over message was jammed or the neighbour was lost, and the sector is unwatched.

rows.name: RelayedReportDroppedHazard
rows.text: About relayReportsThroughNeighbour: a report handed to a neighbour for relay is dropped on the way, and the originating member believes it has been delivered.

rows.name: TrackHandOverGapHazard
rows.text: About handOverTrack and correlateTracks: a track is handed to a drone that does not take it up, or two drones both keep it, so the object is lost or shown twice.

rows.name: SplitCoordinationHazard
rows.text: When jamming partitions the mesh, sub-swarms coordinate separately: two of them take the same sector while another sector is left empty, or two members leave to recharge from the same sector.

rows.name: LostHandoffHazard
rows.text: A sector or a track handed from one member to a neighbour is dropped in the hand-off: the leaving member has gone and the receiving member never took it, so the sector goes unwatched or the track goes stale unnoticed.

rows.name: GroundStationSinglePointHazard
rows.text: All command and control sits in the one ground station: if it or its link is lost, tasking, supervisory priorities, recall and the status picture are unavailable and the operator cannot see or stop the swarm.

rows.name: TriageUnitSinglePointHazard
rows.text: All reports pass through the one triage unit: if it fails, detection reports and decision records stop reaching the operator, or reach them unranked and unmerged.
